definitionZh: 块大小的 CSS 属性定义元素块沿块轴的大小. 如果书写模式是水平的,则对应高度;如果书写模式是垂直的,则对应宽度. 一个相关的属性是内在大小,它定义了元素的另一方面.
sourceDefinition: The block-size CSS property defines the size of an element's block along the block axis. If the writing-mode is horizontal, it corresponds to the height; if the writing mode is vertical, it corresponds to the width. A related property is inline-size, which defines the other dimension of the element.
